landing.f3: In the gym, the screen turns the color of what you're doing, so you can read it from across the room

onboarding.title: Let's build your plan
onboarding.chooseTitle: How do you want to start?
onboarding.generateDesc: Tell us what you want and the AI builds a plan around you.
onboarding.importDesc: Paste or upload your plan. We'll review it and suggest improvements — you decide what to keep.
onboarding.tellHint: Write freely. What do you want to improve? Any muscle you want to focus on? Lose weight, gain muscle? How often can you train? Any injuries? The more you say, the fewer questions we'll ask.
onboarding.tellPlaceholder: e.g. I'm 28, I've trained for 2 years, I want a bigger chest and arms and to lose some belly fat. I can go to the gym Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday for about an hour…
onboarding.tellPlaceholderImport: e.g. I want to grow my glutes and legs while losing weight. I train 4 times a week at a full gym…
onboarding.planPlaceholder: Paste your plan here (any format: exercises, sets, reps, days…)
onboarding.uploadHint: Text file (.txt, .md, .csv) or a photo/screenshot of your plan
onboarding.questionsSubtitle: We filled in what we could from what you wrote. Just answer what's missing.
onboarding.generating: Building your plan with the latest natural-training research…
onboarding.savePlan: Save and go to my dashboard
onboarding.needText: Please write a little about yourself first.
onboarding.needPlan: Please paste or upload your plan.

plan.rirHelp: RIR = reps in reserve (reps left in the tank)

warning.focusLow: {muscle} is a focus muscle but now has {sets} sets a week (we recommend at least {limit}).
warning.maintenanceLow: {muscle} now has {sets} sets a week (at least {limit} keeps what you've built).
warning.weeklyHigh: {muscle} now has {sets} sets a week (more than {limit} is hard to recover from).
warning.sessionHigh: {day}: {sets} sets for {muscle} in one session (more than {limit}; spread them over two days).
warning.weeklyLow: {muscle} now has {sets} sets a week (at least {limit} for your experience).
warning.frequencyLow: {muscle} is now trained on {sets} day(s) a week (at least {limit} is better).
warning.fillerDay: {day} now has only {sets} sets of real muscle work (at least {limit} makes the day count).

import.title: Import a plan
import.desc: Paste your plan or upload a file. We keep your exercises, sets and reps exactly as written.
import.placeholder:
Thursday — Legs
Hack squat — 3×6–10
Leg press — 2×8–12
RDL — 3×6–10
import.uploadHint: Text, PDF, Word (.docx) or a photo/screenshot
import.methodAi: Transcribed by AI. Check that every exercise is right before saving.
import.unreadHint: Add them in the editor after saving, or write them as "Exercise — 3×10" and read again.
import.nothingFound: We couldn't find exercises here. Write one per line, like "Leg press — 3×10".
